about_the_game:
🌌 A Strange World Hidden Beneath the Abyss 🌌

Since ancient times, a catastrophic event has torn the world apart, leaving behind an endless abyss—where the laws of nature are twisted, where forgotten civilizations lie buried, and where only the bravest dare to descend. The Abyss is not just a land... it is a mystery yet to be unraveled.

Are you ready to step into the depths?

🌀 An adventure unlike anything you've ever experienced
Explore 10 unique worlds connected by the Abyss—ranging from prehistoric jungles and the kingdom of golems to cursed plains. Each layer holds a puzzle, a challenge, and a story waiting to be discovered.

⚔️ Fight, survive, and grow
Face creatures never recorded in history, from wandering phantoms to ancient beasts guarding the Abyss's secrets. Craft, upgrade your gear, build your base... Will you fight head-on, or will you find hidden paths few dare to tread?

🛠️ Build, tame, and master the Abyss
Use whatever you can find to develop a farm, extract rare resources, and even tame powerful creatures to fight alongside you. But remember, the Abyss is no easy place to survive...

👥 Co-op with friends or brave the journey alone
Your path can be solitary or shared with others. Will you become an explorer, a treasure hunter, or a seeker of truth?

⛩️ The gate has opened—do you have the courage to step in?

Abyss: New Dawn – The journey into the depths has only just begun…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 1050ti
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i3 7th gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 1050ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A fantasy survival adventure where the Abyss is filled with mysteries and strange worlds. Explore unfamiliar lands, face mystical creatures, and carve your path to survival amidst the chaos. Can you unravel the deep secrets hidden here?
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
